data.statement: Pizza Boss 3000 remained undistributed at its first due checkpoint: zero impressions, saves, Pin clicks, outbound clicks, attributable site sessions, and downstream product clicks about 30 hours after publication.
data.decision: Keep the candidate measuring and do not infer that the visual or clean format failed from a zero-distribution checkpoint.
data.nextAction: Recheck the public Pin at its 7-day checkpoint and compare only after both static-format arms have received distribution.
